description: An open-source Fabric mod that adds an AI companion to Minecraft. Talk to it in chat or by voice, and it will follow you, fetch items, walk to places and mine blocks for you.

mods.name: Friendai
mods.description: An AI companion you can play with and talk to — by chat or voice.

releases.notes:
### Fixed

- The companion rests beside its owner when no useful work is ready. Free-time status shows rest, waits and blocked needs. The watchdog no longer repeats idle messages or bypasses the director's retry limits.

releases.notes:
### Fixed

- Task history distinguishes cancellations and timeouts from other failures. Cancelling work no longer triggers failure recovery, and inventory changes count as task progress only when the task records the work.
- Item acquisition forgets a remembered resource site after directly confirming it is empty. Unreachable, obscured or unloaded sites remain in memory.

releases.notes:
### Fixed

- A stalled model reply ends at the configured request timeout, even if the reply has already started streaming. An invalid provider completion reports an error so the companion can answer the next message.

releases.notes:
### Added

- **Simple Voice Chat** in Settings → Voice → Synthesis (`voice.tts.playback`, Auto by default): with the optional Simple Voice Chat mod installed and connected, the companion's spoken replies play through it from the companion's position, so Sound Physics Remastered adds reverb and muffles the voice behind walls, and the wake word listens to what you say in voice chat instead of opening the microphone a second time. Remove the mod, or disconnect, mute or switch off voice chat, and the built-in output and microphone take over on their own; Off never uses the mod.

mods.name: Friendai
mods.description: An AI companion you can play with and talk to — by chat or voice.

releases.notes:
### Fixed

- The companion waits to land before plotting a walking route, turns toward its first step before walking and keeps moving through vertical descents.
- The companion centres itself over the supporting block before jumping to place scaffolding, so it can start the climb from the edge of a ledge.
- If a scaffold block is protected or unreachable, the companion still removes the other scaffold blocks it can reach and reports any that remain.
- In Creative mode, the companion can fly upward inside a one-block shaft to place a block below itself.
- At night, the companion only starts a shelter reflex when it has a known home to head to, torches and a dark interior to light, or enough blocks to build and enter a shelter nearby. Missing torches no longer prevent it from eating when its health is low.
